t: This is the Cromwell Hospital, a private hospital in South Kensington, run by the healthcare company Bupa. Several notable people died here. They include Lucy Kibaki, who was First Lady of Kenya from 2002 to 2013, and Hubert Ogunde, the Nigerian actor and playwright who founded Nigeria's first contemporary professional theatrical company. The comedian and cartoonist Willie Rushton, a co-founder of Private Eye, also died here, as did the businesswoman Dame Helen Alexander, who was president of the CBI.
